# 性能术语与符号

_Performance Terminology & Symbols_

术语以发动机性能学习语境整理。符号只是常用写法，具体站位、参考状态和单位以所用文献为准；起动、风车、换算参数等概念单独区分。

_Terms are organised for engine-performance study. Symbols are common conventions rather than a universal standard; use the stations, reference conditions and units specified by each source. Starting, windmilling and corrected quantities are distinguished explicitly._

| 中文术语 | English | 符号 / Symbol | 定义与说明 / Definition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 工作包线 | Operating envelope | — | 环境、飞行及发动机工作状态的适用范围。 The applicable range of environmental, flight and engine operating conditions. |
| 设计点 | Design point | DP | 用于定义并比较方案的选定工况。 A selected operating condition used to define and compare engine concepts. |
| 非设计点 | Off-design operation | OD | 设计点以外的工作状态及其部件匹配。 Operation away from the design point and the associated component matching. |
| 总温 | Total temperature | Tt | 与流动动能计入方式有关的温度量；需注明测量与定义。 A temperature quantity that accounts for flow kinetic energy; state the definition and measurement method. |
| 总压 | Total pressure | Pt | 与静压区分的流动压力量；需注明站位。 A flow pressure quantity distinct from static pressure; identify the engine station. |
| 质量流量 | Mass flow rate | ṁ | 单位时间通过截面的质量。 Mass passing through a section per unit time. |
| 气体常数 | Specific gas constant | R | 与工质组成及采用的单位体系有关。 A gas property dependent on composition and the unit convention. |
| 定压比热 | Specific heat at constant pressure | cp | 需注明温度、工质和物性模型。 Specify temperature, working fluid and the property model. |
| 比热比 | Specific-heat ratio | γ | 通常表示定压比热与定容比热之比。 Usually the ratio of constant-pressure to constant-volume specific heat. |
| 压比 | Pressure ratio | PR | 两个指定站位压力之比；总压或静压需说明。 A ratio between pressures at defined stations; identify total or static pressure. |
| 总压比 | Overall pressure ratio | OPR | 整机压缩系统两端的总压比，需注明边界。 The total-pressure ratio across the compression system, with its boundaries specified. |
| 涵道比 | Bypass ratio | BPR | 外涵流量与核心流量之比，需注明定义与站位。 The ratio of bypass to core mass flow, with the definition and stations specified. |
| 换算流量 | Corrected mass flow | ṁcorr | 按给定进口温压及参考基准表示的流量。 Mass flow expressed using defined inlet conditions and reference values. |
| 换算转速 | Corrected speed | Ncorr | 按规定温度参考基准表达的转速。 Rotational speed expressed using a specified temperature reference. |
| 换算参数 | Referred parameters | — | 比较前须核对参考状态、公式和单位。 Check the reference state, formula and units before making comparisons. |
| 相似参数 | Similarity parameters | — | 用于描述相关物理效应之间相对关系的参数组。 Groups used to compare the relative importance of relevant physical effects. |
| 热效率 | Thermal efficiency | ηth | 描述热能向有用机械能转换的效率。 Efficiency describing the conversion of thermal energy into useful mechanical energy. |
| 推进效率 | Propulsive efficiency | ηp | 描述推进能量转化为有效推进功的程度。 A measure of how effectively propulsive energy produces useful propulsive power. |
| 推力耗油率 | Thrust-specific fuel consumption | TSFC | 燃油质量流率与推力之比；需同时注明单位和工况。 Fuel mass flow divided by thrust, with units and operating conditions stated. |
| 涡轮进口温度 | Turbine inlet temperature | TIT | 必须注明具体站位、平均方式和测量定义。 Specify the station, averaging method and measurement definition. |
| 燃气发生器 | Gas generator | — | 由压气机、燃烧室和涡轮组成的核心功能组合。 The functional combination of compressor, combustor and turbine. |
| 部件匹配 | Component matching | — | 使部件流量、功率和状态相互协调。 Compatibility between component flows, power and operating states. |
| 失速 | Stall | — | 与叶片或部件气动状态有关，不能与喘振完全等同。 An aerodynamic condition at blade or component level; not interchangeable with surge. |
| 喘振 | Surge | — | 压缩系统的非稳定工作现象，需与局部失速区分。 An unstable compression-system phenomenon, distinct from local stall. |
| 稳定裕度 | Stability margin | — | 与选取的失稳边界及计算定义相关。 A margin that depends on the chosen instability boundary and calculation convention. |
| 瞬态 | Transient | — | 随时间从一个状态向另一个状态过渡的过程。 A time-dependent transition between operating states. |
| 起动 | Starting | — | 建立发动机自主持续运行的过渡过程。 The transition toward self-sustaining engine operation. |
| 风车状态 | Windmilling | — | 气流驱动未正常燃烧输出的发动机转子旋转。 Airflow-driven engine rotation without normal combustion-powered output. |
| 亚慢车 | Sub-idle | — | 正常慢车以下、可能需要单独建模的区域。 The region below normal idle, which may require separate modelling. |
| 性能退化 | Performance deterioration | — | 相对于可比基线的性能变化，须排除工况等干扰。 A change from a comparable performance baseline after accounting for confounding conditions. |
| 数据换算 | Data reduction | — | 由试验测量计算和整理为可解释性能结果。 Processing test measurements into interpretable performance results. |
| 全寿命成本 | Life-cycle cost | LCC | 在规定寿命阶段与边界内累计的成本。 Costs accumulated over defined life-cycle stages and system boundaries. |
